updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role enables least-privilege access to device onboarding in Endpoint DLP, allowing auditors and security analysts to view device status without requiring broad admin roles like Compliance Administrator. This reduces risk by limiting administrative privileges while maintaining necessary visibility into device management operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An authorized attacker can exploit a sensitive information exposure flaw in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector to disclose information locally. Admins should apply available security patches to prevent unauthorized access to connector configuration or authentication credentials.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: Improper certificate validation in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass security controls over the network. Admins managing certificate-based authentication should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized certificate acceptance.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70240: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A memory leak in Windows Kerberos allows an unauthorized attacker to cause denial of service attacks over the network. Organizations should apply patches promptly as Kerberos is critical to authentication across Windows environments and identity services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-95884: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Buffer Over-Read
updates.summary: A buffer over-read flaw in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services can allow an authorized attacker to disclose sensitive information across the network. Admins operating certificate infrastructure should patch to prevent exposure of PKI data and certificates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions within the Purview portal, making it easier for admins to troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor who accessed what resources. This improvement strengthens compliance auditing and access governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Purview is expanding auto-labeling support for larger SharePoint scopes and improving policy management flexibility alongside enhanced visibility into labeling activity. These updates enable enterprises to apply sensitivity labels more consistently across vast data estates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view detailed per-policy coverage reports showing which files have been labeled and how enforcement aligns with simulation snapshots. This visibility helps track auto-labeling progress and identify gaps in coverage for specific policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum daily auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and better prepare data estates for Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics tool helps users understand why DLP policies are triggered, showing which conditions evaluated true or false and the order of evaluation. E5 customers also receive Copilot-powered insights to accelerate policy troubleshooting and optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync & Device Health AI Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered visibility now helps admins track DLP policy deployment across devices, identify sync failures, and understand root causes with recommended remediation actions. This reduces the time needed to diagnose and resolve device compliance issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Restrict Access Action for Fabric Semantic Models and Lakehouses
updates.summary: Organizations can now use DLP policies to restrict access to Fabric semantic models and lakehouses based on detected sensitive information, blocking guest or all users depending on content matches. This extends data protection to Fabric analytics platforms beyond audit and notification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes with eligible E5 licenses can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention capabilities and preventing mailboxes from becoming inoperative. This enables scalable archive growth for organizations with high data retention requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: New Copilot readiness and data explorer experiences in Purview Data Security Posture Management provide enhanced visibility into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage to assess Copilot readiness. These tools help security teams investigate findings and prioritize remediation efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitoring for FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and applies restrictive actions based on organization policy. Admins can configure FTP and SFTP activities in DLP policies to extend data protection beyond traditional file-sharing channels.
